en: Job 28

p.src: 1  “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

en: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
u.src: 1  “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

p.src: 2  Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

en: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
u.src: 2  Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

p.src: 3  Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

ja: に終わりを設け、 最果ての境まで探し求める。
がりと深い暗闇にある
en: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
u.src: 3  Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

p.src: 4  He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

en: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
u.src: 4  He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

p.src: 5  As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

ja: については、そこからパンが出るが、 その
によるかのように覆される。
en: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
u.src: 5  As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

p.src: 6  Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

ja: その岩からはサファイアが採れ、 そこには
en: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
u.src: 6  Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

p.src: 7  That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

en: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
u.src: 7  That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

p.src: 8  The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

ja: たちもそこを歩いたことはなく、
en: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
u.src: 8  The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

p.src: 9  He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

en: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
u.src: 9  He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

p.src: 10  He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

en: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
u.src: 10  He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

p.src: 11  He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

en: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
u.src: 11  He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

p.src: 12  “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

ja: りの住みかはどこにあるのか。
en: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
u.src: 12  “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

p.src: 13  Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.

en: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.
u.src: 13  Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.

p.src: 14  The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

en: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
u.src: 14  The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

p.src: 15  It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

ja: って代価とすることもできない。
en: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
u.src: 15  It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

p.src: 16  It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

ja: でもその値を量れず、 高価な縞めのうやサファイア でも足りない。
en: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
u.src: 16  It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

ja: 28:16 あるいは、ラピスラズリ
en: 28:16 or, lapis lazuli

p.src: 17  Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

ja: もガラスもそれに等しくはなく、 純
en: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
u.src: 17  Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

p.src: 18  No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

ja: 珊瑚や水晶は挙げるまでもない。 そうだ、
en: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
u.src: 18  No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

p.src: 19  The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.

ja: エチオピアのトパーズもそれに等しくはなく、
en: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.
u.src: 19  The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.

p.src: 20  Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

ja: りの住みかはどこにあるのか。
en: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
u.src: 20  Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

p.src: 21  Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

ja: からも遠ざけられている。
en: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
u.src: 21  Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

p.src: 22  Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

en: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
u.src: 22  Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

p.src: 23  “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

ja: を悟り、 その住みかを
en: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
u.src: 23  “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

p.src: 24  For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

en: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
u.src: 24  For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

p.src: 25  He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

en: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
u.src: 25  He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

p.src: 26  When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

en: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,
u.src: 26  When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

p.src: 27  then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

ja: て明らかにし、 これを
en: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
u.src: 27  then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

p.src: 28  To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

ja: から遠ざかること、それが
en: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
u.src: 28  To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

ja: 28:28 「主」と訳された言葉は「アドナイ」である。
en: 28:28 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”
